en: When liquid water boils, it expands about 1,700 times in volume to become water vapor.
Ice floats on liquid water because solid ice is about nine percent less dense than liquid water.
You can dissolve a maximum of 360 grams of table salt into one liter of room-temperature water.
When iron rusts, it combines with oxygen, increasing the original metal's total weight by about 30 percent.
A single small drop of pure water contains approximately 1.5 sextillion individual water molecules.
Compressing air into a standard scuba tank reduces its volume by about 200 times compared to normal atmospheric pressure.
Pure gold melts at exactly 1,064 degrees Celsius, which is much hotter than boiling water's 100 degrees Celsius.
Whole milk is a liquid mixture containing about 3.5 percent fat globules suspended in watery fluid.
The sun consists of plasma, a superheated state of matter reaching 15 million degrees Celsius at its core.
Baking bread causes yeast to produce gas, expanding the dough to roughly twice its original volume.
Diamond is the hardest natural solid material, scoring a perfect 10 on the 1-to-10 Mohs hardness scale.
Silver is the best electrical conductor among metals, transmitting electricity about five percent more efficiently than copper.
